snp_profile.pharmacogenomic_summary: SLCO1B1 TT: highest-risk statin myopathy genotype - OATP1B1 transporter loss-of-function leads to 5x increased statin plasma exposure. Atorvastatin 40mg is unsafe at this variant. CYP2C19 AA: poor metabolizer - clopidogrel requires CYP2C19 bioactivation; therapeutic failure documented by platelet reactivity. VKORC1 GA: intermediate warfarin sensitivity (relevant if anticoagulation considered). SLC22A1 GA: intermediate metformin efficacy.

clinicianNotes: PT-003 represents a critical pharmacogenomic safety case. Two concurrent genotype-drug mismatches: (1) SLCO1B1 TT on atorvastatin 40mg - CK is 485 U/L (>2x ULN), patient has symptomatic myalgia and self-discontinued. Dose should be reduced to ≤20mg or switched to pravastatin/fluvastatin (not OATP1B1 substrates) or rosuvastatin at reduced dose. (2) CYP2C19 AA on clopidogrel post-NSTEMI - platelet reactivity 242 PRU confirms inadequate antiplatelet effect. Cardiology consultation urgent - consider switch to prasugrel (avoid if prior stroke/TIA) or ticagrelor. WHOOP (avg recovery 45, HRV 31.7) and CGM (TIR 42%, avg 165 mg/dL) suggest moderate metabolic burden. Diabetes management secondary to resolving drug safety issues.
